limitations: Current-survivor proxy universe; not a point-in-time ETF universe.
Yahoo auto-adjusted prices are a total-return proxy, not issuer NAV authority.
Macro and event snapshots are prospective context only; holdings, futures-curve, FX and tax inputs are absent.

methodology.curve: month-end historical observations in the same 10-point opportunity-score band
methodology.downside_risk: positioning-unwind watch requires prior 58-session gain >=15%, 5-session loss >=6%, relative loss versus SPY >=4%, and 21-session drawdown >=9%; only a material negative event upgrades it to downside bias
methodology.final_score: price score plus bounded fresh catalysts, decaying persistent sentiment, historical analogs, risk, and state-transition inputs; repeated coverage cannot multiply one theme
methodology.opportunity: 75% cross-sectional 21/63/126-session total-return momentum rank + 25% positive-trend confirmation
methodology.risk: equal-weight cross-sectional 63-session volatility and 126-session drawdown ranks

DEFENSE_ORDERS.rationale: Verified defense procurement/industrial events: Japan-Philippines $27M radar/drone pact, US-Poland defense industry statement, Rocket Lab $270M DoD loan, Patriot stock depletion, UK $121M counter-systems investment, F-35 parts tracking failure, drone purchase order, and GCC unified command.

ECONOMIC_GROWTH.rationale: Macro growth data with global transmission: OECD unemployment stability, strong US jobs report lowering rate-cut odds, S&P Israel upgrade, Taiwan GDP forecast lift, Kazakhstan growth, EU services output, South Africa unemployment, and US recession gauges.

ENERGY_SUPPLY.rationale: Material supply-side state changes: OPEC output recovery, attacks on Saudi East-West pipeline bypassing Hormuz, price rebound/volatility, US Brent forecast revision, EU offshore wind aid, and demand shifts (China LNG cuts, Lithuania gas pivot, Iraq Khor Mor attack).

FINANCIAL_STRESS.rationale: Systemic credit/liquidity signals: AI-credit stress (CoreWeave yield), Brazil shadow-bank defaults with regulatory scrutiny, broad US consumer delinquency rise, Taiwan capital outflows, EM credit-growth slowdown, and mortgage/appraisal stress; used to gauge credit-spread risk.

HEALTH_POLICY.rationale: Policy-driven reimbursement and drug-pricing state changes: 2027 Medicare physician pay cut, denied Minnesota Medicaid funds, Medicare-at-50 bills, Medicaid work-rule uninsured impact, Nebraska denials, FDA drug approval, FDA AI-device risk flags, and signed Medicare/bankruptcy bills.

MILITARY_GEOPOLITICS.rationale: Verified state changes and authoritative statements on Iran conflict trajectory (Trump/Rubio pause signals, Hormuz threats, US force posture), new sanctions (Canada-Iran), North Korea war prep, and a US terror plot charge affecting UK base security; used for geopolitical risk premia monitoring.

MONETARY_INFLATION.rationale: Authoritative macro data and central-bank signals: hot US CPI raising hike odds, Fed speakers opening half-point door, BoE inflation stance, Argentina disinflation, Ukraine inflation, MAS gold vaulting, and ECB communication framework.

POLITICAL_SOCIAL_SHOCK.rationale: Verified political/shock state changes: US shutdown-avoidance deal, Israel state-of-emergency government formation, Pacific earthquakes, Florida hurricane landfall, Liberian election concession, UAE Gaza flood aid, and December shutdown risk; excluded speculative and local-only items.

PRECIOUS_METALS.rationale: Fewer than eight distinct verified global-market events; kept central-bank gold buying, Singapore central-bank vaulting (central-bank demand infrastructure), bullish analyst outlook, and producer-level supply news, excluding promotional and stock-picking items.

TECHNOLOGY_AI.rationale: Material AI-sector state changes: US legislative push to restrict China AI-chip access amid Nvidia probe, Anthropic $3.4B gas data-center deal, Google TPU launch challenging Nvidia, CoreWeave revenue beat, grassroots data-center bans raising siting risk, chip-materials M&A, and China semiconductor export surge.

TRADE_CONTROLS.rationale: Verified policy actions with cross-border transmission: China tariff suspension extension and new anti-dumping duties, US tariff continuity post-election, Canada tariff relief changes, Norwegian salmon penalty removal, EU-US Airbus tariff dispute, and AI export-control crackdown risk.
